title: Test score cutoff and college enrollment
research_question: Does crossing a test score threshold for automatic college admission increase actual enrollment rates?
data_description: Cross-sectional data on 600 high school graduates. Variables: running_var (standardized test score, 0–1; cutoff = 0.5), treated (1 if score ≥ cutoff), y (enrolled in college binary as continuous proxy), near_cutoff (within ±0.3 bandwidth). Sharp RDD.
